text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Before the URA Finals championship race. 
Trainer Kiryuin looks straight into your 
eyes, ready to clash with everything she's 
got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through every word, one can feel the 
spirit and passion of the two, who have 
stacked effort upon effort and grown 
stronger each time they tasted defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The URA Finals— The final round is about 
to begin!
